_label: Illustrative planning zones curated from public reporting of Cyclone Michaung (Dec 2023). NOT official flood maps. Radius is a planning heuristic around the reported estate, not a surveyed boundary.

zones.name: Ambattur Industrial Estate, north phase
zones.note: Public reporting: the north phase of the Ambattur Industrial Estate stood in water for days after Cyclone Michaung (KNN India, 2023-12-07: 'The North phase has three sectors. Water is slowly receding in sector one while the other two sectors are still [flooded]'); The Hindu (2023-12-04): 'The Ambattur Industrial Estate was the most affected. Water seeped into many units.' Estate loss estimated at ~Rs 2,000 crore (The Week, 2023-12-06).

zones.name: Villivakkam
zones.note: Public reporting: Villivakkam industrial estate units flooded days after the storm receded, water reaching shop floors and damaging machines, finished goods and raw materials (Deccan Herald, 2023-12: 'MSME units around Chennai see damages of over Rs 3,000 cr').

zones.name: Thirumudivakkam industrial estate
zones.note: Public reporting: the industrial estates at Ambattur, Thirumudivakkam, Perungudi, Thirumazhisai and Kakkalur were 'still submerged in four to six feet of water' two days after landfall (The Week, 2023-12-06); The Hindu Businessline lists Thirumudivakkam among the estates where flooding crippled MSME operations.

zones.name: Perungudi industrial estate
zones.note: Public reporting: Perungudi listed among government-developed industrial estates where flooding crippled MSME units (The Hindu Businessline, 2023-12-08); The Week (2023-12-06) reports it submerged in four to six feet of water.

zones.name: Guindy - Adyar low-lying belt
zones.note: Public reporting: Chennai's Guindy/Adyar belt, draining into the Adyar river and Buckingham Canal, saw widespread waterlogging and closure of industrial units during Michaung (The Hindu, 2023-12-04: 'Downpour forces industrial units to suspend operations in Chennai'; Times of India, 2023-12-06, on the Ambattur-Padi cluster; Wikipedia: businesses impacted by flooding and power shortages). Larger units resumed within days (Indian Express: >90% of large-scale units resumed).

cited_against.oragadam: Not flooded: 'situation in Oragadam, another automobile hub in the suburbs... was better' with large industrial parks resuming operations after Cyclone Michaung (Deccan Herald, 2023-12, reporting the Tamil Nadu government statement).
